entities.summary: Socialist Republic, a political institution in Vietnam during Reunification and Isolation (1975–1979). Grew from Sino-Vietnamese War — China invades Vietnam's northern border. Led to the emergence of Vietnam invades Cambodia and topples the Khmer Rouge and International Isolation and Economic Crisis.
